text:
Ava: Heads up — landing at HND super early tomorrow (6:10am). Totally jetlagged. Looking for something warm and fast near Hamamatsucho. Conbini breakfast (onigiri + hot coffee) or hunt down a tiny ramen spot that opens stupidly early? Any local recs? :yawn:
Diego: Conbini is a safe bet if you're wiped. 7‑Eleven modan sandwich + onigiri + a hot can coffee — fast and cheap.
Priya: If you want actual ramen, try Menya Maru near Hamamatsucho. Opens 5:30am, small counter seats, excellent shoyu. Cash only sometimes.
Sam: +1 for Menya Maru. Standing ramen bars are common — you get in/out quick. Also watch for holiday hours.
Marta: If you end up closer to Tamachi/Shiba, there's a tiny place called 'Shiba-no-Soba' that does warm soba and kitsune — open early and lighter than ramen.
Ava: Hotel is literally a 7min walk from Hamamatsucho station. If ramen line is long, conbini it is. Any quick coffee/pastry recs for a calmer option?
Diego: Tully's near the station opens early, or Cozy Cafe on the first floor of the hotel building sometimes opens at 6:30. If you want local: 'Convenience store hot snack' is a mood lol.
Priya: Also pro tip: get a hot oden cup from the conbini if you want warm broth without the queue.
Sam: Quick directions if you go ramen: from HND take Keikyu -> Hamamatsucho, exit A1, 10min walk to Menya Maru.
Sam: ```
Keikyu -> Hamamatsucho (exit A1)
walk 7-10m south along the tracks
look for the red noren, tiny counter
```
Marta: Poll time: ramen vs conbini? React with the emoji you prefer. I'll tally. :ramen: :onigiri:
Ava: Ramen :ramen:
Diego: Conbini :onigiri:
Priya: Ramen :ramen:
Sam: Ramen :ramen:
Marta: Ramen :ramen:
Ava: Looks like ramen wins 4-1. Thank you team — I'll try Menya Maru and report back (or send a photo of my sleepy face). :sweat_smile:
